name: Fabric
description: Lightweight mod loader. The launcher downloads the Minecraft server itself on first start.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to install (for example 1.21.11), 'latest' for the newest release or 'snapshot' for the newest snapshot. Current versions need Java 25; pick an older Java image for older versions.

variables.name: Fabric Loader Version
variables.description: Fabric loader version (for example 0.20.1), or 'latest' for the newest stable loader.

variables.name: Fabric Installer Version
variables.description: Version of the Fabric installer that builds the server launcher, or 'latest'. Rarely needs changing.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Name the Fabric server launcher is saved as; the startup command runs it.
